_doc: The fleet's git repositories, as data, for the Sync tab's Git subpage. The family is the SAME curated 8 the SuperApp's GH Repos / Gitea Repos cards reuse: these two cards read 'the same repos, two remotes' instead of one card being a long unrelated list (aa_cloud-superapp/build.json, github_feed section). Gitea mirrors EVERY non-fork GitHub repo except cloud-vault (mirror_policy.exclude) — a longer list than these 8 — but this tab deliberately lists the curated family so the mirrors and the upstream read as one set.
_doc_secret_rule: Repositories are public or imported public mirrors; nothing here authenticates. A private read needs a GitHub token this app does not store — that is stated in the subpage, not faked.

instances.auth: anonymous for public reads; a token is needed for private repos and the app does not store one

_doc_clone: #575 Every repository here is cloned INTO THE ONE SHARED STORE (ac_cloud-drive/build.json::storage.shared_root) as <root>/<name>, by the page's Clone/Open button: the target folder and the upstream URL (https://<github host>/<github_owner>/<name>.git, composed from the github instance above) are handed to the native git manager (libs:git-sync), which asks only for a token when the repository is private. A folder that already holds the clone opens instead of cloning. Nothing here is a path: the root lives in build.json and the page reads it through FilesBridge.sharedRoot().
_doc_private: private: true marks a repository the anonymous read cannot fetch: the git manager stores the HTTPS token the user types in its keystore-backed credential store (GitCredentialStore), never in this file and never in .git/config.
_doc_seed: #603 SEEDING THE SHARED STORE. `seed: true` marks one of the SIX repositories (cloud, cloud-u-android, cloud-infra, cloud-infra-desktop, cloud-u-containers, cloud-u-linux) the store is populated with on FIRST RUN (build.json::storage.seed): StoreSeed registers it in libs:git-sync's RepoRegistry as <shared_root>/<name> and clones it SHALLOW (depth 1) through GitEngine.clone — no second git, and no clone bytes inside the APK, which could not carry them and would ship them stale. PUBLIC REPOSITORIES ONLY, and that is not a preference: an anonymous clone of a private repository fails every time, so seeding one would bake a permanent red. `public: true` states the fact the flag rests on. front-assets-cdn and diegonmarcos.github.io are public but deliberately NOT in the seeded six; every repository marked `private: true` here (cloud-data-my-ai-memory, front-data) carries NO seed flag; all four stay declared-not-cloned on the Git sub-page, where the user can type the HTTPS token the credential store then holds for the private ones.
